value.rationale: The four-child Sylvester–Hadamard contrast system is a natural multiresolution choice distinct from the dyadic nested contrasts. Equality of their sharp finite endpoint unconditionality constants under a two-level blocking is a nontrivial, structurally motivated invariance, and the theorem provides the exact all-depth growth and multiplicity of sharp ancestral sign patterns. The fact supplies a sharp benchmark for the effect of basis packetization rather than an arbitrary small-instance computation.
